name: Ananya Iyer
text: The kundan choker arrived beautifully boxed and looked better than the photos. Wore it to my cousin's mehendi and was asked about it all evening.

name: Rohit Menon
text: Ordered a pendant for my wife's birthday. Delivery took a day longer than promised, but the hallmark certificate and the finish made up for it.

name: Meera Deshpande
text: My second order from Morchadi. The bangles I bought last Diwali still look new, so I did not think twice about coming back.

name: Karthik Raghavan
text: Checkout was quick and a tracking link came through within hours. The jhumkas are far lighter than they look, which my mother loved.

name: Sneha Bhattacharya
text: Genuinely good quality for the price. I returned one ring for a smaller size and the exchange was handled without any fuss.

name: Aditya Kulkarni
text: Bought an anklet set for my sister's wedding. The packaging felt premium and every stone is properly set, nothing loose or catching.
